text_block_list.text: New Year's Day—as we welcome the new year, a quiet and solemn atmosphere fills the academy grounds...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Haaaaappy New Yeeeeear!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's go train!
Cutting straight through the New Year's greetings, Winning Ticket made her declaration.

Even so, on the schedule,
today is supposed to be New Year's break.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
When I realize the Derby is this year,
I get this... ungh, this stirring deep in my chest!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I just couldn't sit still,
and before I knew it, I was standing in front of this room!"

As she speaks, Winning Ticket's eyes
sparkle, brimming with motivation.

It would be a shame to crush their newfound motivation.
I should make a suggestion—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And guess what! I came up with something!
The ultimate New Year's training plan!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I call it Operation One-Fuji, Two-Hawk, Three-Eggplant!
We climb Mt. Fuji, eat eggplants, and finish off skydiviiing with a hawk!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! That's definitely gonna be super fun! Wait up, I'm gonna go buy some hiking boots—
Saying so, I caught her just in the nick of time as she was about to rush out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? What's wrong!?
Should I go buy some for you too, Trainer?

If she's just going to run wild,
it'd be better for me to give the orders.
choice_data_list: Let's come up with a special move!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: A marathon!? Nice! Sounds like fun!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I read a marathon manga the other day!
Running without giving up until the very end,
and overtaking them right at the last second...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO~N! I'm so moved~~!!
I won't give up and will do my best too~!

—Whatever the case, a brand-new year
with Winning Ticket had begun.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Conserve stamina?
Does that mean we should just chill and rest!?
choice_data_list: Resting is an important part of training, too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Then you gotta get plenty of rest!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right! Now that that's settled, nap time!
Winning Ticket slumped face down onto the desk in the Trainer's Room—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah!
She had fallen asleep with all her might...!

—Whatever the case, a brand-new year
with Winning Ticket had begun.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A special moveee!?
That's so cooool!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I was totally thinking that looked kinda cool~~~! Yeah, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I wanna sprint right through like *whooosh*, just like a cheetah!

—Whatever the case, a brand-new year
with Winning Ticket had begun.
